{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].index

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicate_count}')
print(f'Patient IDs with multiple rows: {list(duplicate_patients)[:5]}...')

# Check sample_seq per patient
print('\nSample sequence max per patient:')
print(df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())

# Verify that -999 in biomarker_baseline is a sentinel
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print('\nAssay batch distribution:')
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
